<# .SYNOPSIS Render a command invocation as a human-friendly table or machine-friendly JSON. .DESCRIPTION `Show-InvocationTable` accepts a hashtable, PSCustomObject, or array of name/value entries and prints a formatted table showing parameter names, values, and types. It also supports a `-Format json` mode that emits a JSON array for automation. .PARAMETER Args The arguments to display. Accepts a hashtable (`[ordered]@{}` recommended), PSCustomObject, or an array of objects with `Name`/`Value` properties. .PARAMETER Title Title text printed above the table. .PARAMETER Width Maximum total width used for layout. Defaults to 80. .PARAMETER ShowMode Which parameters to show: `Provided` (default), `Eligible`, or `Both`. .PARAMETER EligibleParams Optional array of param descriptors (Name, Default, Type, Help) used when showing eligible set. .PARAMETER Format `table` (default) or `json` or `compact`. .EXAMPLE . .\show-invocation-table.ps1 Show-InvocationTable -Args $PSBoundParameters -Title 'Invocation' -Format table #> function Show-InvocationTable { param( [Parameter(Mandatory=$true)][object]$InvocationArgs, [string]$Title = 'Command Invocation', [string]$InvocationLine = $null, [int]$Width = 80, [ValidateSet('Provided','Eligible','Both')][string]$ShowMode = 'Provided', [object[]]$EligibleParams, [switch]$AutoDiscoverEligible, [ValidateSet('table','json','compact')][string]$Format = 'table', [switch]$ShowMeta, [int]$MaxValueWidth = 60, [switch]$Wrap, [switch]$ShowTypes, [switch]$ShowEmpty ) # Helper: convert inputs to normalized entries function Convert-ToEntriesInner { param($Input) $entries = @() if ($null -eq $Input) { return $entries } if ($Input -is [System.Collections.IDictionary]) { foreach ($k in $Input.Keys) { $v = $Input[$k] if ($v -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable] -and -not ($v -is [string])) { $disp = ($v | ForEach-Object { $_ }) -join ',' } else { $disp = $v } $type = if ($null -ne $v) { $v.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' } $entries += [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = [string]$k; Value = $disp; Type = $type; Provided = $true; Default = $null } } return $entries } if ($Input -is [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject]) { $props = $Input | Get-Member -MemberType NoteProperty | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name foreach ($p in $props) { $v = $Input.$p if ($v -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable] -and -not ($v -is [string])) { $disp = ($v | ForEach-Object { $_ }) -join ',' } else { $disp = $v } $type = if ($null -ne $v) { $v.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' } $entries += [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = [string]$p; Value = $disp; Type = $type; Provided = $true; Default = $null } } return $entries } if ($Input -is [System.Array]) { foreach ($item in $Input) { if ($item -is [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject] -and $item.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Name') { $name = $item.Name $val = $item.Value if ($val -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable] -and -not ($val -is [string])) { $dispVal = ($val | ForEach-Object { $_ }) -join ',' } else { $dispVal = $val } $type = if ($null -ne $item.Type) { $item.Type } elseif ($null -ne $val) { $val.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' } $providedFlag = if ($item.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Provided') { $item.Provided } else { $true } $defaultVal = if ($item.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Default') { $item.Default } else { $null } $entries += [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = [string]$name; Value = $dispVal; Type = $type; Provided = $providedFlag; Default = $defaultVal } } } return $entries } # Handle IEnumerable enumerators (OrderedDictionary, Hashtable enumerator, etc.) if ($Input -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable] -and -not ($Input -is [string])) { foreach ($it in $Input) { if ($it -is [System.Collections.DictionaryEntry]) { $k = $it.Key; $v = $it.Value if ($v -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable] -and -not ($v -is [string])) { $disp = ($v | ForEach-Object { $_ }) -join ',' } else { $disp = $v } $t = if ($null -ne $v) { $v.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' } $entries += [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = [string]$k; Value = $disp; Type = $t; Provided = $true; Default = $null } } elseif ($it.PSObject -and $it.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Key' -and $it.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Value') { $k = $it.Key; $v = $it.Value if ($v -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable] -and -not ($v -is [string])) { $disp = ($v | ForEach-Object { $_ }) -join ',' } else { $disp = $v } $t = if ($null -ne $v) { $v.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' } $entries += [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = [string]$k; Value = $disp; Type = $t; Provided = $true; Default = $null } } } if ($entries.Count -gt 0) { return $entries } } # Fallback: return a single-entry with default name return ,([PSCustomObject]@{ Name = 'Args'; Value = $Input; Type = if ($null -ne $Input) { $Input.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' }; Provided = $true; Default = $null }) } function Get-ParamsFromScript { param([string]$ScriptPath) $out = @() if (-not $ScriptPath) { return $out } if (-not (Test-Path $ScriptPath)) { return $out } $content = Get-Content -Raw -Path $ScriptPath -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue if (-not $content) { return $out } $m = [System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex]::Match($content, 'param\s*\((.*?)\)', [System.Text.RegularExpressions.RegexOptions]::Singleline) if (-not $m.Success) { return $out } $paramText = $m.Groups[1].Value # normalize and split by commas $paramText = $paramText -replace "`r?`n", ' ' $tokens = $paramText -split ',' | ForEach-Object { $_.Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -ne '' } foreach ($t in $tokens) { # remove attribute blocks with parentheses like [Parameter(...)] but keep simple type annotations like [string] $s = $t -replace '\[[^\]]*\([^\]]*\)\]', '' $s = $s.Trim() # match [type]$name = default OR $name = default OR [type]$name $rx = '^(?:\s*\[(?[^\]]+)\]\s*)?\$?(?[A-Za-z0-9_]+)(?:\s*=\s*(?.*))?$' $mm = [System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex]::Match($s, $rx) if ($mm.Success) { $name = $mm.Groups['name'].Value $type = $mm.Groups['type'].Value if (-not $type) { $type = 'Unknown' } $default = $mm.Groups['default'].Value if ($default) { $default = $default.Trim() # strip trailing parentheses or trailing tokens $default = $default.TrimEnd(')') $default = $default.Trim() $default = $default.Trim('"','''') } else { $default = $null } $out += [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = $name; Type = $type; Default = $default } } } return $out } function Show-TableInner { param($entries, $ShowTypesFlag, $WidthVal, $WrapFlag, $TitleVal, $InvocationLineVal) # compute widths $nameWidth = ([int](($entries | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name | ForEach-Object { $_.Length } | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum)) if ($nameWidth -lt 8) { $nameWidth = 8 } if ($nameWidth -gt 30) { $nameWidth = 30 } $typeWidth = if ($ShowTypesFlag) { 12 } else { 0 } $providedWidth = if ($ShowMeta) { 9 } else { 0 } $defaultWidth = if ($ShowMeta) { 20 } else { 0 } $metaWidth = $providedWidth + $defaultWidth if ($ShowMeta) { $metaWidth += 2 } $padding = 6 $valueWidth = $WidthVal - $nameWidth - $typeWidth - $metaWidth - $padding if ($valueWidth -lt 20) { $valueWidth = 20 } # Raw invocation line (if provided) if ($InvocationLineVal) { Write-Host "Invocation: $InvocationLineVal" -ForegroundColor DarkGray } # Header Write-Host $TitleVal -ForegroundColor Cyan # Columns: Param-Arg, Type, Provided, Default, Value $hdr = ('{0,-' + $nameWidth + '} {1,-' + $typeWidth + '} {2,-' + $providedWidth + '} {3,-' + $defaultWidth + '} {4,-' + $valueWidth + '}') $colLabels = @('Param-Arg','Type','Provided','Default','Value') Write-Host ($hdr -f $colLabels) -ForegroundColor Yellow Write-Host ('-' * ($WidthVal)) -ForegroundColor DarkGray foreach ($e in $entries) { $name = $e.Name $val = if ($null -eq $e.Value) { '' } else { $e.Value.ToString() } # Sanitize display strings if helper is available $sanitizer = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'sanitize-output.ps1' if (Test-Path $sanitizer) { . $sanitizer } try { $val = Sanitize-DisplayString $val } catch {} $type = if ($ShowTypesFlag) { $e.Type } else { '' } if (-not $WrapFlag -and $val.Length -gt $valueWidth) { $val = $val.Substring(0, $valueWidth - 1) + '...' } # multiline values: split on newlines and print subsequent lines indented under Value column $lines = $val -split "`n" $first = $lines[0] $prov = if ($e.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Provided') { $e.Provided } else { $true } $def = if ($e.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Default') { $e.Default } else { '' } $typeVal = if ($ShowTypesFlag) { $e.Type } else { '' } # Print in order: Name, Type, Provided, Default, Value Write-Host ($hdr -f $name, $typeVal, $prov, $def, $first) -ForegroundColor Gray if ($lines.Count -gt 1) { for ($i = 1; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) { $ln = $lines[$i] $padLength = $nameWidth + 2 + $typeWidth + 2 + $providedWidth + 2 + $defaultWidth + 2 $pad = ' ' * $padLength try { $ln = Sanitize-DisplayString $ln } catch {} if (-not $WrapFlag -and $ln.Length -gt $valueWidth) { $ln = $ln.Substring(0, $valueWidth - 1) + '...' } Write-Host ($pad + $ln) -ForegroundColor DarkGray } } } } # Normalize provided args (handle OrderedDictionary and related types directly) $provided = @() if ($InvocationArgs -ne $null -and ($InvocationArgs -is [System.Collections.IDictionary] -or $InvocationArgs.GetType().FullName -eq 'System.Collections.Specialized.OrderedDictionary')) { foreach ($k in $InvocationArgs.Keys) { $v = $InvocationArgs[$k] if ($v -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable] -and -not ($v -is [string])) { $disp = ($v | ForEach-Object { $_ }) -join ',' } else { $disp = $v } $t = if ($null -ne $v) { $v.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' } $provided += [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = [string]$k; Value = $disp; Type = $t; Provided = $true; Default = $null } } } elseif ($InvocationArgs -is [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject]) { $props = $InvocationArgs | Get-Member -MemberType NoteProperty | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name foreach ($p in $props) { $v = $InvocationArgs.$p if ($v -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable] -and -not ($v -is [string])) { $disp = ($v | ForEach-Object { $_ }) -join ',' } else { $disp = $v } $t = if ($null -ne $v) { $v.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' } $provided += [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = [string]$p; Value = $disp; Type = $t; Provided = $true; Default = $null } } } elseif ($InvocationArgs -is [System.Array]) { foreach ($item in $InvocationArgs) { if ($item -is [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject] -and $item.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Name') { $name = $item.Name; $val = $item.Value $t = if ($null -ne $item.Type) { $item.Type } elseif ($null -ne $val) { $val.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' } if ($item.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Provided') { $pf = $item.Provided } else { $pf = $true } if ($item.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Default') { $df = $item.Default } else { $df = $null } $provided += [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = [string]$name; Value = $val; Type = $t; Provided = $pf; Default = $df } } } } elseif ($InvocationArgs -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable] -and -not ($InvocationArgs -is [string])) { foreach ($it in $InvocationArgs) { if ($it -is [System.Collections.DictionaryEntry]) { $k = $it.Key; $v = $it.Value if ($v -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable] -and -not ($v -is [string])) { $disp = ($v | ForEach-Object { $_ }) -join ',' } else { $disp = $v } $t = if ($null -ne $v) { $v.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' } $provided += [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = [string]$k; Value = $disp; Type = $t; Provided = $true; Default = $null } } elseif ($it.PSObject -and $it.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Key' -and $it.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Value') { $k = $it.Key; $v = $it.Value if ($v -is [System.Collections.IEnumerable] -and -not ($v -is [string])) { $disp = ($v | ForEach-Object { $_ }) -join ',' } else { $disp = $v } $t = if ($null -ne $v) { $v.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' } $provided += [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = [string]$k; Value = $disp; Type = $t; Provided = $true; Default = $null } } } } else { $provided = ,([PSCustomObject]@{ Name = 'Args'; Value = $InvocationArgs; Type = if ($null -ne $InvocationArgs) { $InvocationArgs.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' }; Provided = $true; Default = $null }) } # Auto-discover eligible params from the invocation line when requested if ($AutoDiscoverEligible -and -not $EligibleParams -and $InvocationLine) { # extract script path from invocation line: & "path" or & path $scriptPath = $null $m = [System.Text.RegularExpressions.Regex]::Match($InvocationLine, '&\s*(?:"(?[^"]+)"|(?

[^\s]+))') if ($m.Success) { if ($m.Groups['q'].Value) { $scriptPath = $m.Groups['q'].Value } else { $scriptPath = $m.Groups['p'].Value } } if ($scriptPath) { try { $found = Get-ParamsFromScript -ScriptPath $scriptPath } catch { $found = @() } if ($found -and $found.Count -gt 0) { $EligibleParams = $found } } } # If eligible mode requested and EligibleParams provided, merge if ($ShowMode -ne 'Provided' -and $EligibleParams) { $eligible = @() foreach ($p in $EligibleParams) { $n = $p.Name $hasDefaultProp = $p.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Default' $defaultVal = if ($hasDefaultProp) { $p.Default } else { $null } $existing = $provided | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq $n } if ($existing) { foreach ($row in $existing) { if (($null -eq $row.Default -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$row.Default)) -and $hasDefaultProp) { $row.Default = $defaultVal } if (($null -eq $row.Type -or $row.Type -eq 'Unknown' -or $row.Type -eq 'Null') -and $p.Type) { $row.Type = $p.Type } } continue } $eligible += [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = $n; Value = if ($hasDefaultProp) { $defaultVal } else { $null }; Type = if ($p.Type) { $p.Type } else { 'Unknown' }; Provided = $false; Default = $defaultVal } } $entries = $provided + $eligible } else { $entries = $provided } if ($Format -eq 'json') { $out = $entries | Select-Object Name,@{Name='Value';Expression={[string]($_.Value)}},Type,Provided,Default # ConvertTo-Json can throw on complex objects; use Depth 5 $json = $out | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 Write-Output $json return } Show-TableInner -entries $entries -ShowTypesFlag:$ShowTypes -WidthVal $Width -WrapFlag:$Wrap -TitleVal $Title -InvocationLineVal $InvocationLine } function Convert-ToEntries { param($Input) $entries = @() if ($null -eq $Input) { return $entries } if ($Input -is [System.Collections.IDictionary]) { foreach ($k in $Input.Keys) { $v = $Input[$k] $type = if ($null -ne $v) { $v.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' } $entries += [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = [string]$k; Value = $v; Type = $type; Provided = $true; Default = $null } } return $entries } # OrderedDictionary can sometimes not match IDictionary checks in some hosts; handle explicitly if ($Input -ne $null -and $Input.GetType().FullName -eq 'System.Collections.Specialized.OrderedDictionary') { foreach ($k in $Input.Keys) { $v = $Input[$k] $type = if ($null -ne $v) { $v.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' } $entries += [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = [string]$k; Value = $v; Type = $type; Provided = $true; Default = $null } } return $entries } if ($Input -is [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject]) { $props = $Input | Get-Member -MemberType NoteProperty | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name foreach ($p in $props) { $v = $Input.$p $type = if ($null -ne $v) { $v.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' } $entries += [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = [string]$p; Value = $v; Type = $type; Provided = $true; Default = $null } } return $entries } if ($Input -is [System.Array]) { foreach ($item in $Input) { if ($item -is [System.Management.Automation.PSCustomObject] -and $item.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Name') { $name = $item.Name $val = $item.Value $type = if ($null -ne $item.Type) { $item.Type } elseif ($null -ne $val) { $val.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' } $providedFlag = if ($item.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Provided') { $item.Provided } else { $true } $defaultVal = if ($item.PSObject.Properties.Name -contains 'Default') { $item.Default } else { $null } $entries += [PSCustomObject]@{ Name = [string]$name; Value = $val; Type = $type; Provided = $providedFlag; Default = $defaultVal } } } return $entries } # Fallback: return a single-entry with default name return ,([PSCustomObject]@{ Name = 'Args'; Value = $Input; Type = if ($null -ne $Input) { $Input.GetType().Name } else { 'Null' }; Provided = $true; Default = $null }) } function Show-Table { param($entries) # compute widths $nameWidth = ([int](($entries | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name | ForEach-Object { $_.Length } | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum)) if ($nameWidth -lt 8) { $nameWidth = 8 } if ($nameWidth -gt 30) { $nameWidth = 30 } $typeWidth = if ($ShowTypes) { 12 } else { 0 } $padding = 6 $valueWidth = $Width - $nameWidth - $typeWidth - $padding if ($valueWidth -lt 20) { $valueWidth = 20 } # Header Write-Host $Title -ForegroundColor Cyan $hdr = ('{0,-' + $nameWidth + '} {1,-' + $valueWidth + '}') if ($ShowTypes) { $hdr += (' {2,-' + $typeWidth + '}') } if ($ShowTypes) { $typeLabel = 'Type' } else { $typeLabel = '' } Write-Host ($hdr -f 'Name','Value',$typeLabel) -ForegroundColor Yellow Write-Host ('-' * ($Width)) -ForegroundColor DarkGray foreach ($e in $entries) { $name = $e.Name $val = if ($null -eq $e.Value) { '' } else { $e.Value.ToString() } # sanitize $sanitizer = Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'sanitize-output.ps1' if (Test-Path $sanitizer) { . $sanitizer } try { $val = Sanitize-DisplayString $val } catch {} $type = if ($ShowTypes) { $e.Type } else { '' } if (-not $Wrap -and $val.Length -gt $valueWidth) { $val = $val.Substring(0, $valueWidth - 1) + '...' } # multiline values: split on newlines and print subsequent lines indented under Value column $lines = $val -split "`n" $first = $lines[0] if ($ShowTypes) { Write-Host ($hdr -f $name, $first, $type) -ForegroundColor Gray } else { Write-Host ($hdr -f $name, $first) -ForegroundColor Gray } if ($lines.Count -gt 1) { for ($i = 1; $i -lt $lines.Count; $i++) { $ln = $lines[$i] $pad = ' ' * ($nameWidth + 2) try { $ln = Sanitize-DisplayString $ln } catch {} if (-not $Wrap -and $ln.Length -gt $valueWidth) { $ln = $ln.Substring(0, $valueWidth - 1) + '...' } Write-Host ($pad + $ln) -ForegroundColor DarkGray } } } } return
